mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO shopion.tOrdOrderProdStockLog (OrderNo, OrderProdNo, Action, ProdCode, Qty, RegistDate, RegistId) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{orderProdNo}, 'DEDUCT', #{prodCode}, #{qty}, NOW(), #{registId})

INSERT IGNORE INTO shopion.tOrdOrderProdStockLog (OrderNo, OrderProdNo, Action, ProdCode, Qty, RegistDate, RegistId) SELECT OrderNo, OrderProdNo, 'RESTORE', ProdCode, Qty, NOW(), #{registId} FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProdStockLog WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND Action = 'DEDUCT'
mapper.select: SELECT ProdCode AS prodCode, Qty AS qty FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProdStockLog WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND Action = 'DEDUCT'
